snippet.title: Beyond the Dark: Nightwatch | Harvest of Terror: A Horror Game Awards Halloween 2026 Trailer
snippet.description:
Beyond the Dark: Nightwatch is a two-player asymmetric co-op horror experience from Atlantis Studio where communication is your only way out. One player is trapped inside a mysterious House, exploring in first person while being hunted by THE ENTITY; the other watches through a network of surveillance cameras, uncovering clues, spotting dangers and guiding their partner from the outside. Two players, two screens, two completely different perspectives — and one shared escape. Thanks to the Friend’s Pass, only one player needs to own the game for a friend to join for free. Beyond the Dark: Nightwatch launches October 22, 2026 on Nintendo Switch 2. Discover more: beyondthedark.com
---
Originally aired during HARVEST OF TERROR: a Horror Game Awards Showcase on Wednesday 7 October 2026.
---
Set up by two die hard horror game fans, the aim of The Horror Game Awards is simple: to celebrate horror as one of the best genres in video games and to recognise the year’s greatest horror games alongside the developers who make them.
